name: Legacy Texture Pack
author: Stryke
description:
Port de 276 imagens do resource pack Legacy Texture Pack, de Stryke. Substitui os assets de textura encontrados pelo nome no jogo mobile. Elementos exclusivos do PC podem ficar sem efeito e imagens com medidas diferentes podem exigir ajustes.

Descricao do pacote original:
Legacy Texture Pack resprites Terraria to be a bit cleaner and more detailed!
It includes over 250 sprites, mostly items and tiles
The pack is updated every a week

Join our Discord server to stay up to date with new textures and to suggest items to be resprited next!
https://discord.gg/FMdzxVDCsd
